fields.h1: Build a Talent Show Sign-Up Sheet That Sets the Lineup
fields.hero_description: Build a talent show sign up sheet where each act enters its length, its members, and what it needs on stage from a phone.
fields.explore_cta: Build My Talent Show Sign-Up Sheet
fields.features_heading: What the Sheet Sorts Out Before Rehearsal
fields.features_subheading: A talent show sign up sheet settles who performs, for how long, and in what order. Describe your show, and Emergent builds it.
fields.feature_1:
One question per screen on a phone

Asks a performer one thing at a time, from the act name to the minutes it runs. A parent filling it in at pickup or a student between classes never has to squint at a crowded grid.
fields.feature_2:
A time limit the sheet enforces

Checks each act's length against the limit you set for the show. An entry over the limit goes back to the performer with the cap shown, before the act can join the lineup.
fields.feature_3:
Groups entered once, with every name

Lets a band or dance crew sign up as one act and list every member and grade. Each name is counted toward that student's total, so a cap on acts per student holds for groups too.
fields.feature_4:
Stage needs and tracks on the entry

Asks how many mics an act needs, whether it uses the piano, and for its backing track as a file. The stage crew works from one cue sheet, not a pile of notes and texts.
fields.feature_5:
A running order you can rearrange

Turns the sign-ups into a numbered lineup with each act's length and running total. Set a rule such as no two songs in a row, and the order follows it as new acts sign up.
fields.feature_6:
Code that leaves with you

Exports the full codebase to your GitHub repository on paid plans. A school district or a theater can host the sheet on its own servers and reuse it for every season's show.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Shows and the Sheet Behind Each
fields.tab_content_1:
Every act gets 3 minutes, and the yo-yo routine needs 4

Orsolya Trelawney chairs the PTA at Maplewick Elementary, and her spring show holds every act to 3 minutes. The sheet has 22 acts so far. A parent signs up Cazimir Wetherell's yo-yo routine and enters 4 minutes. The form shows the 3-minute limit and asks for a shorter act before it saves the entry.
fields.tab_content_2:
Two acts each, and a third for Emeric goes on hold

Isolde Moncrieff casts the winter show at Coldharbour High, and each student may appear in 2 acts. The Velvet Static dance crew signs up with 5 members. Emeric Dunholm is in the crew, and he already has 2 acts: a guitar solo and a band. The crew's entry goes on hold on Isolde's review list until she decides.
fields.tab_content_3:
One email tells Solenne that Fitzgerald needs the piano

Solenne Marchbanks runs the stage for the Quarrington Community Theater fundraiser, and she has one piano. Every act lists its mics and uploads a backing track when it signs up, and 14 of 16 tracks are in. Fitzgerald Blackwood asks for the piano and 2 mics. The app emails Solenne his request as soon as he submits.
fields.tab_content_4:
Seraphina Ortolan's song waits one slot for the comic

Clemency Pinkney emcees the Wetherby Packaging charity show, and her running order holds 12 acts. It never puts 2 singing acts back to back. The Kitchen Crew Choir sings in slot 4. Seraphina Ortolan's song moves from slot 5 to slot 6, and Hollister Pettibone's comedy set takes slot 5 between them.

fields.hero_prompt: Build a talent show sign up sheet for my school's spring show where each act enters its name, length, and stage needs.

faq_plan.q: What is a talent show sign up sheet?
How do I create a talent show sign up sheet?

plan.angle: The top 10 for talent show sign up sheet is printables (Etsy, Twinkl, Scribd, a PDF to pin on the office door) and generic registration templates (Jotform, Cognito, FormNX): a grid of names and acts that the organizer then turns into a running order by hand. This page shows the sheet as a phone form that does the organizer's sorting: an elementary PTA show that holds every act to 3 minutes, a high school show where no student appears in more than 2 acts, a community fundraiser where piano and mic requests reach the stage manager before rehearsal, and a workplace charity show whose running order keeps 2 singing acts apart. The FAQ covers what to ask, act length, group acts, running order, closing dates, workplace shows and what to keep off the sheet.
tab_stories: At Maplewick Elementary, PTA chair Orsolya Trelawney holds every act to 3 minutes, so when a parent enters 4 minutes for Cazimir Wetherell's yo-yo routine, the form asks for a shorter act before it saves; 22 acts are signed up.

At Coldharbour High, drama teacher Isolde Moncrieff allows each student 2 acts, so when the Velvet Static dance crew lists Emeric Dunholm, who is already in 2 acts, the crew's entry goes on hold on Isolde's review list.

At the Quarrington Community Theater fundraiser, every act lists its mics and uploads a backing track, and when Fitzgerald Blackwood asks for the piano, the app emails stage manager Solenne Marchbanks; 14 of 16 tracks are in.

At the Wetherby Packaging charity show, emcee Clemency Pinkney's running order of 12 acts never puts 2 singing acts back to back, so Seraphina Ortolan's song moves from slot 5 to slot 6, after Hollister Pettibone's comedy set.
